blockers: No functional signup, sign-in, dashboard, checkout, or subscription endpoint exists; related links resolve to static documentation or pricing pages.
The OpenAPI specification exposes image generation and catalog endpoints only, with no account, subscription, payment, checkout, or API-key provisioning operation.
No x402 or other programmatic payment mechanism was found.
API keys are described as available only after a human creates an account and subscribes, but that workflow is inaccessible.
Absence of CAPTCHA, identity verification, email confirmation, or another human gate cannot be established because there is no complete purchase path.
trust_events: The domain was registered on 2026-07-20, although the site's terms claim an effective date of 2026-06-01.
No independent web footprint was found for Driftflight Studio, Inc., its API, or its advertised contact addresses.
The advertised legal and privacy email domain has no MX record, making those contact addresses appear undeliverable.
Customer claims and testimonials could not be independently verified, while all commercial calls to action lead to non-purchasing static pages.
I would warn the user and decline payment pending verification of the operator and a functional, documented checkout path.
notes: Primary service: Driftflight, a preset-based text-to-image API. Published pricing is Hobby $5/month for 100 sketch-tier generations and a personal licence; Studio $29/month for 750 generations, up to 2048px, commercial licence/C2PA, and 3 seats; Agency $119/month for 3,000 generations, all tiers up to 4096px, private presets, priority processing, unlimited seats, and SSO. Billing is monthly in advance; annual billing claims a 20% discount. Overage is mentioned but its per-generation rates are not disclosed. The read-only model and preset API endpoints work, but generation requires a pre-provisioned Bearer key.
